record.step: To find the smallest possible value of $ |m - n| $ given the equation $ 3m + 4n = 100 $, we can express one variable in terms of the other and analyze the resulting expression. This gives us a condition on $ n $: $ 100 - 4n \equiv 0 \pmod{3} $, or $ 4n \equiv 100 \pmod{3} $. Simplifying, $ 4n \equiv 1 \pmod{3} $, and since $ 4 \equiv 1 \pmod{3} $, this reduces to $ n \equiv 1 \pmod{3} $. Thus, $ n $ must be of the form $ 3k + 1 $ for some integer $ k $.
